Mining reference used during the V8 review

Reviewed: content/skills/mining, or-cache/.../tables/skills/Mining.kt,
api/utils/utils-skills/.../SkillingSuccessRate.kt.
The volcanic-ash chance coefficients (50/200), interpolation and ordinary
pickaxe action delays were used as a reference for the Java implementation.

This project's current content includes changes after 2022. It was not
imported wholesale. Its ash activity also lacked the complete ash-specific
yield/soda/depletion rules: those were implemented separately using the
pre-2023 activity reference and checked against the local cache/map.

2022 gameplay references:
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ash_pile
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Volcanic_ash
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Celestial_ring

No completion percentage from another emulator is treated as validation
of content in this game. Uncovered effects remain in the skill audit.
